1 صَالَ , aor. يَصِيلُ, i. q. صال having for its aor. يَصُولُ, (Ibn-'Abbád, O, K,) i. e. He (a man) leaped or sprang [&c.]. (Ibn-'Abbád, O.) ＝
-A2- صِيلَ لَهُمْ كَذَا, (S and K in art. صول,) or لَهُ, (Ibn- 'Abbád and O and K in the present art.,) Such a thing was appointed, or ordained, or prepared, for them, or for him. (Ibn-'Abbád, S, O, K.) This is its proper place. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
